summary.name: Memphis Design. This is a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Playful pattern-led graphic style. Dots, zigzags, stripes, circles and irregular geometry appear in bold contrasting colours. Patterns establish rhythm through alternating shapes, elastic offsets and pattern handoffs. The headline must stay readable.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: playful brand and pattern pieces. Suggested pairings point to logo stings, onboarding illustrations, stickers, and short social clips with emphasis captions. Motion posters and music-synchronized pieces are listed as compatible. These are inferred from the catalog, not verified against a brief.
summary.limitations: Avoid rapid full-frame flashing and limit simultaneous movement. The headline stays readable and never deforms. Avoid captions over faces or subtitles. Do not use dense explanatory text or gentle illustrative sequences. Choose no motion reference when the scene's assets do not support its defining action.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent. The #FFF6E8 swatch is an illustrative suggestion, not a required canvas, and the source review shows backgrounds change per scene. Suggested tokens are foreground #202039 and accents #ED718E, #3DBAB1, #F4C64F, with no gradient. Exact task colours override these. Two-colour contrast is 14.769 for foreground on background, and 5.541 to 9.824 for foreground on accents. Verify composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Optional motion references: motion-037 phrase scatter, motion-038 punctuation zoom (needs actual punctuation), motion-039 radial logo burst (needs an approved mark), and motion-040 word smash cuts. Variants include a keyword-glyph portal, a burst-masked word swap, and a squash-to-band card flip. Scene patterns motion-007, -012 and -015 are optional. Drive all state from composition time with deterministic seeks. Use elastic accents on only a few hero shapes, with no automatic bounce.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified in the source. No soundtrack, voice or sound effect is required. Background music, sound accents and silence are all valid options chosen from the topic. Music synchronization is compatible only after inspecting actual audio; the source reviews assessed visual frames only. Leave room for speech and reading holds.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploaded assets, exact copy, fonts, logos or brand marks are specified. Inspect glyph assets or approved mark geometry before building pattern or morph effects. Preload local fonts before rendering. Do not invent product copy or brand marks. Source review covered only seconds 1–8 of two external creator videos, as reference evidence, not assets to reuse.
summary.combinations: style-115 emphasis captions: timed stressed-word captions with outlines of #202039 on accents, framed by zigzags, with only one pattern animating at a time and live-region text. style-106 squash-and-stretch: a few hero shapes deform with preserved area and anticipation. Avoid every shape bouncing, continuous wobble and deformed text.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: SVG patterns and reusable shape groups per tech.implementation. Motion engine: one paused, seekable GSAP timeline, with optional Motion, mo.js bursts, or pre-cached Matter.js poses. Each property has one owner. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with Remotion as fallback only when a recorded reason applies. Validate with check and snapshot, and verify seeks and frames.
